name: Netlify
description: Netlify is a unified platform to "create with AI or code, deploy instantly on production infrastructure," supporting deploys via Git, CLI, drag-and-drop, or AI agents.
best_for: Positioned for diverse teams — product engineers, AI developers, marketers, designers, and ops personnel — building AI-powered apps, marketing sites, e-commerce storefronts, fullstack apps, and internal tools.
features: Multiple deploy paths: Git, CLI, drag-and-drop, AI Agent Runners
AI Gateway for model access (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini)
Global edge network (100+ locations) with 99.99% uptime SLA

alternatives.name: Vercel
alternatives.description: Agentic infrastructure for deploying web apps and AI agents at global scale with Git-connected preview deploys.
alternatives.best_for: Developers and platform builders deploying apps and autonomous agent workflows.

alternatives.name: Docker
alternatives.description: A platform for building, shipping, and running containerized applications.
alternatives.best_for: Developers and enterprises standardizing application packaging/deployment via containers.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: Starts with 3,000 credits/month and unlimited team seats; higher credit tiers available.

cons: Credit-based plans meter production deploys, compute, bandwidth, web requests, and other usage; plan price is not necessarily the full bill.
On Free, projects pause when the monthly credit limit is reached; legacy accounts created before September 4, 2025 can have different pricing rules.
